description: Whether a node's distribution listener is pinned to loopback, given the operator's ERL_EPMD_ADDRESS (BT-5127, BT-5185). The value is a comma-separated address list; each entry is trimmed and blanks are skipped. The listener is left unpinned only when some entry parses as an IP address that is not loopback: that is a deliberate private-network opt-out. Addresses are parsed strictly (four dotted decimal fields for IPv4; an IPv6 %zone suffix is ignored; an IPv4-mapped IPv6 address counts as its IPv4 address). Unset, blank, loopback (127.0.0.0/8, ::1, localhost) and unparseable values pin, so a typo fails closed. Rust beamtalk_workspace::loopback_dist_for and Elixir BtAttach.Workspace.loopback_dist?/1 both read this file.

cases.name: loopback list with spaces and blanks
shorthand ipv4 is not an address
leading-zero ipv4 is not an address
